misses.why: Hubbard was [trending up](https://sleeper.com) after Tepper's early-week practice reps and a soft run-defense matchup - both dated before kickoff.
No pre-kickoff signal pointed at Irving over Dowdle; both were healthy full-workload backs. Irving's game script broke well after the whistle.

waiver_misses.name: Payne Durham
waiver_misses.why: Durham was added by 15% of leagues after Tampa Bay's Wednesday injury report ruled out its starting TE.

lessons: Check practice-report RB trends before locking strict-slot starters, not just the FLEX comparison.
Scan the waiver wire for backup TEs when the starter is questionable Wednesday, not just Sunday morning.
summary: The lineup, not the roster, lost this one: 31.4 points sat on the bench in a 15.34-point loss. Every miss was at running back: McCaffrey and Dowdle started; Hubbard and Irving outscored both.
